title: Así como: comparar y sumar elementos paralelos

sections.content: Así como can mean just as (drawing a parallel between two situations) or as well as (adding a second parallel item to a first). It's a flexible connector for synthesis writing, where several related ideas need to be tied together smoothly. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Millones de personas cruzaron la frontera entre ambos mundos, así como ideas, música, literatura y tecnología circularon en ambas direcciones.
items.english: Millions of people crossed the border between both worlds, just as ideas, music, literature, and technology circulated in both directions.

items.spanish: La migración latinoamericana hacia Estados Unidos, así como la inversión y el turismo estadounidenses hacia América Latina, crearon vínculos profundos.
items.english: Latin American migration to the United States, as well as American investment and tourism toward Latin America, created deep ties.

items.spanish: La relación entre Estados Unidos y América Latina fue, así como sigue siendo hoy, tan compleja como profundamente entrelazada.
items.english: The relationship between the United States and Latin America was, just as it continues to be today, as complex as it was deeply intertwined.

items.spanish: Los historiadores reconocen la cooperación real que existió, así como los episodios innegables de intervención y dependencia económica.
items.english: Historians acknowledge the real cooperation that existed, as well as the undeniable episodes of intervention and economic dependency.

sections.content: Así como sits between two parallel elements, not at the start of a sentence introducing a single idea -- if you want just as at the start of a sentence, use tal como or de la misma manera que instead.
